description: Looks up hand-verified facts about a local business by name and city: legal name, locations, published prices (each with its source URL and the date it was verified), hours, an ownership statement, the audit date, and what is not yet verified. Every record was entered by hand from the business's own published sources, with the business's written consent to be published here. A business not found returns a plain NOT_FOUND result. Free tool, no API key required.
name: get_verified_business_facts
